desc: Riding Yoshi into a scene (chapter 2), the guard beside yoshi_rider_lost_hei_01: Mario rides Yoshi from Boggly Woods' mri_03 into mri_04 while the Puni elder is imprisoned (story 92), where Ms. Mowz's scene (chuchurina_sogu) stops the party before it normalizes Mario, as hei_01's tip scene does. Here the scene waits for the door first, so Yoshi's dismount plays and Mario stands; the scene and its battle play (TTYD_AUTO_BATTLE), then he walks off with control, never left in the saddle
